title: "Resources"

## Open science practice

-   [BES guides](https://www.britishecologicalsociety.org/content-type/better-science-guides/) The British Ecological Society has a series of guides to research excellence on topics like data management, reproducible coding and more.
-   [BioST\@TS](https://biostats-r.github.io/biostats/) BioST\@TS is an online platform with everything you need to know to write your thesis in R (Working in R, Git/GitHub, Quarto, targets, and making R packages).

## Data collection - Fieldwork

[**Qfield**](https://qfield.org/) Efficient field data collection tool.

## Reproducible workflows

[Quarto template](https://github.com/biostats-r/quartothesis) A template for a thesis written in quarto.

## Society / Community

[**SORTEE**](https://sortee.org/)Society for Open, Reliable, and Transparent Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
